def choose_move(observation):
    agent_state = observation.get('agent', {})
    position = agent_state.get('position', (0, 0))
    resources = observation.get('resources', [])
    enemies = observation.get('enemies', [])
    territory = observation.get('territory', {})
    border = territory.get('border', [])
    def get_closest(targets):
        return min(targets, key=lambda t: abs(t[0]-position[0]) + abs(t[1]-position[1])) if targets else None
    # Combine all targets metadata
    all_targets = []
    if resources:
        all_targets.extend(resources)
    if enemies:
        all_targets.extend(enemies)
    if border:
        all_targets.extend(border)
    target = get_closest(all_targets)
    if target:
        dx = (target[0] - position[0])
        dy = (target[1] - position[1])
        dx = (dx > 0) - (dx < 0)
        dy = (dy > 0) - (dy < 0)
        return [dx, dy]
    else:
        # Move randomly when no targets
        return [0, 1]
